story.title: Kalu and Malu
paragraphs_en: Today, Malu went to pluck vegetables from the garden for the first time. He plucked red tomatoes, long brinjals and fresh green lady fingers.
His grandma said, " Great job, Malu! Go and bring some potatoes too."
Malu searched everywhere through the trees, climbers and the bushes but he could not find the potatoes anywhere.

Malu kept the empty basket down and said, " Grandma, the potatoes haven't grown yet." " No Malu, there are a lot of potatoes growing in the garden, look carefully for them.", explained the grandmother.
Malu again went to the garden. Kalu followed him.
Malu was in the middle of the search when he heard, " BOW! BOW! BOW!" "Uh oh! stop stop Kalu, don't spoil the garden.", said Malu running towards Kalu.
" WOW Kalu! you have found the potatoes," said Malu filling the basket with the potatoes.
